title: Classifying multipartite continuous-variable entanglement structures through data-augmented neural networks
methods: quantum data augmentation (mode permutation + convex combination)

data_scope.data_nature: entirely simulated; no external observational dataset
data_scope.noise_test_states: hundreds (exact count not stated in main text)
data_scope.availability: Code Ocean https://doi.org/10.24433/CO.9492084.v2 ; GitHub XiaotingGaoPhys/Multipartite-Entanglement-Classification-QDA ; Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20928779

core_conclusion: A convolutional network fed only with binned homodyne correlation patterns can classify the full multipartition entanglement structure of arbitrary multipartite continuous-variable states without tomography. The decisive ingredient is quantum data augmentation: label-preserving transformations derived from physics (mode permutation, convex mixing of separable states) that expand a scarce simulated training set at negligible cost, lifting accuracy from 0.961 to 0.986 (tripartite, 6x), 0.796 to 0.928 (quadripartite, 24x) and 76.7% to 92.4% (five-mode, 100x), versus 0.370 for a QFI + maximum-likelihood baseline.
why_it_matters: Attacks the label-scarcity bottleneck rather than model capacity (largest gain at the smallest training set); makes an experimentally infeasible density-matrix-based label practically obtainable from cheap homodyne data; the augmentations are provably label-preserving rather than heuristic; the model generalizes to thermal/phase noise, finite sampling and a physically distinct SPDC state family; and it offers a reusable recipe grounded in quantum resource theory free operations.
why_nature: A portable ML principle (derive augmentations from the invariances of the label) demonstrated on a hard physical instance; layered benchmarking with two non-trivial baselines, an ablation, error bars over n=4 runs and a training-set-size sweep; explicit stress tests for discretization, statistical fluctuation and out-of-distribution states; scalability shown to five modes with its computational limits stated plainly; and full reproducibility artefacts on Code Ocean, GitHub and Zenodo.
added_value_to_my_research: Augment-vs-encode decision rule: encode facility-set permutation invariance inside 2SFCA catchments architecturally, augment only unprovable invariances
Certified mixup: mix only where the label class is provably closed, enabling one-class detection of primary-care and mental-health service deserts
Sim-to-real blend ratio: pre-train on ABM-simulated mobility, inject a ~1-2% real mobile-phone/GPS fraction and locate the accuracy knee
Learnable measurement design: recast spatial aggregation and multi-source fusion channels as a budget-constrained learnable observation layer
Partition-lattice classification: supervised, lattice-aware alternative to modularity-based community detection for urban agglomeration and job-housing regions
